HOrbitalDiagonal.finiteKernel_originalHaar_orbital_trace.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K))
  [lambda.IsHaarMeasure] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsHaarMeasure]
  (b : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), 0 < b x)
  (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E] (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) :
  have c := (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda).haarScalarFactor mu;
  have k := DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A;
  have orbit := fun q x =>
    ↑(∑' (t : Kˣ),
          NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * x) *
            NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K
              ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q⁻¹ * x))) *
      k ↑((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q⁻¹ * x) ↑x;
  0 < c ∧
    Integrable (fun x => ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x) * ∑' (q : Kˣ), orbit q x) lambda ∧
      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
          ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x) * ∑' (q : Kˣ), orbit q x ∂lambda =
        ↑↑c * Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)
